name: flagship-one-bit
description: Flagship theme one-bit (cmux#47278), with its type set as settings for builds before the theme-file font keys.

files.themes/one-bit.json:
// 1-Bit: ultra minimal. Black and white and one grey, no picture, no glass, square edges, monospace
// everywhere, nothing that moves. Copy it to ~/.config/cmux/themes/one-bit.json (yours wins over
// this one), edit and save: the running app repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "1-Bit",
  "description": "Black, white and one grey. No picture, no glass, monospace, still.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors: greys only, so the danger, success and warning tones show as
  // weight, not hue.
  "appearance.theme": "Sequoia Monochrome Dark",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#131313",
    "foreground": "#fcfcfc",
    "cursor": "#fcfcfc",
    "selection": "#3a3a3a",
    "accent": "#fcfcfc",
    "0": "#131313",
    "1": "#fcfcfc",
    "2": "#c8c8c8",
    "3": "#e0e0e0",
    "4": "#a8a8a8",
    "5": "#d0d0d0",
    "6": "#b8b8b8",
    "7": "#e8e8e8",
    "8": "#606060",
    "9": "#ffffff",
    "10": "#dcdcdc",
    "11": "#f0f0f0",
    "12": "#c0c0c0",
    "13": "#e4e4e4",
    "14": "#d4d4d4",
    "15": "#ffffff"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "appearance.saturation": 0,

  // Nothing behind the window.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 1,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0,

  // Bare chrome, one rail of icons, hairlines between sections.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "bare",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#131313",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",
  "sidebar.density": "compact",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#131313",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#131313",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "border",

  // Type: monospace for reading too.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "hanken",
  "agentPane.display.font.preset": "mono",
  "markdown.font.preset": "mono",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 12,

  // Still: no animation, a static white dot for work.
  "ui.calm": "still",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "static",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#fcfcfc",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 0,

  "appearance.density": "compact"
}
